title: Custom GitHub agent repositories missing (#3861)
reality: v2.3.4 adds disabled-by-default custom GitHub agent repositories to Agents Manager — a third-party agent-source path with manual preview/apply, explicit trust confirmation, stable sync identity, and bounded SSRF-safe archive validation (#3861). agents.md's 'Download Agents library' and 'Package catalog' sections describe an official-catalog-only model.
fix: In the 'Downloadable Agents (v2.3)' section of references/agents.md, add a '(2.3.4) Custom GitHub repositories' subsection after 'Package catalog': disabled by default; added per-repo in Agents Manager; updates are manual preview/apply (no auto-sync); each repo requires an explicit trust confirmation; repos keep a stable sync identity across updates; archives are validated with bounded, SSRF-safe fetching (#3861). Soften the official-only framing where the catalog is introduced.

title: Export/import section predates #3953 hardening
reality: v2.3.4 (#3953): imported agent files can no longer install bundled custom functions, grant themselves tool access, or overwrite a curated Agent by reusing its internal type; exports no longer bundle function definitions; imported agents receive a fresh custom identity and the user must review and explicitly re-attach tools. agents.md's 'Exporting & importing agents (v2.0)' section still says a complex agent 'can travel with related files/code' with no mention of these restrictions.
fix: Update the 'Exporting & importing agents' section: keep the JSON / folder-zip transfer formats, but add a '(2.3.4)' note that exports omit function definitions, imports never carry executable custom functions or tool grants, an import always lands as a fresh custom-identity agent, and tools must be explicitly re-attached after import (#3953).

title: Background agent no longer generates images
reality: v2.3.4 removed the Background agent's image-generation toggle and runtime path entirely: it now only selects existing library backgrounds. Illustrator owns automatic and Gallery background generation; the Roleplay Gallery's Background action routes through Illustrator's background prompt mode (#3809), and Gallery-generated backgrounds are applied to the active Roleplay chat rather than attached as ordinary illustrations. agents.md still says the background agent 'picks/generates the scene background image.'
fix: Edit the `background` entry in references/agents.md: 'selects the scene background from the existing background library. (2.3.4) Its image-generation toggle and runtime were removed — the agent never generates images; automatic and Gallery background *generation* belong to Illustrator (#3809).' Keep the v2.1 Game-Mode manual-pin note.

title: Illustrator entry lacks background-generation ownership
reality: As of v2.3.4, Illustrator owns automatic background generation and the Gallery Background action, which goes through Illustrator's background prompt mode (#3809); Gallery-generated backgrounds apply to the active Roleplay chat.
fix: In the `illustrator` entry, add a '(2.3.4)' sentence: Illustrator owns all background *generation* — automatic Roleplay backgrounds and the Gallery Background action (Illustrator's dedicated background prompt mode, #3809); generated backgrounds are applied directly to the active Roleplay chat. Cross-reference the Background agent entry ('selection only').

title: Source-of-truth cites deleted agent-registry.generated.ts

The empty built-in list now lives in packages/shared/src/types/agent.ts as `export const BUILT_IN_AGENTS: BuiltInAgentMeta[] = []`, populated at runtime from package manifests; legacy downloadable-agent package parsing is preserved. BUILT_IN_AGENT_IDS (21 entries), RETIRED_BUILT_IN_AGENT_IDS, and BuiltInAgentMeta remain in types/agent.ts.
fix: In the 'Source of truth' paragraph, replace the agent-registry.generated.ts / BUILT_IN_AGENT_MANIFESTS reference with the BUILT_IN_AGENTS array in packages/shared/src/types/agent.ts and note the #3847/#3848 cleanup (also removed: unused agent/turn-game contract members, duplicate tool arrays, Visual Novel types, chat-mode definitions).

title: Music DJ 250-track recent history not documented
reality: v2.3.4 expanded Music DJ's shared recent-track history to 250 Spotify tracks so 50-song candidate batches rotate across large playlists instead of repeatedly drawing from the same small recent window.
fix: Append to the `spotify` (Music DJ) entry: '(2.3.4) The shared recent-track history covers the last 250 Spotify tracks, so 50-song candidate batches rotate across large playlists.'
